params.2184:
These four foes feature as guardians to four diamonds used to gain entrance to a pyramid in the Kharidian desert.

Quest: Desert Treasure

Combat: You need to fight this dangerous quartet together. Damis has two versions that you must defeat and attacks with melee. Fareed will penalise anyone not wearing ice gloves, attacking with his magic fire attacks. Kamil fights with magic and will occasionally freeze you. Dessous will make use of his patented bat attack to deal magic and ranged damage, should you choose to use one of those protection prayers.
